### 1. Native Official Export (All Data / Bulk)

OpenAI allows you to export your entire chat history and account data directly from your account settings.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF14S7Je14zeDPvP69PcF81gAVavUhMxHncvRALHlks64Q4KsBYMd054l5lFbeKD7wn1nxEnYFtjcGKuuKdz6j2NLQNnh3bmhBAWKmnehm3NREO35tTK7MHmu8N13G4B_QZ1BR37DduiqMSAM7PKlGHXKRgt-as0Au9JRAS9LeFI6rafAO12r5EJePjrg)

### How to do it:

1. Open [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXwJMpN4GDKmm2-mlsOTgXXhkihXbkBmpTX-v7GWqh_48Z5z-yHAFDsvI6-MUspqZvuB-uFMHYS_JdFoE-YQeIxjy-I98y1ysw8M0l) in your web browser and sign in.
2. Click on your **profile icon** in the bottom-left corner.
3. Select **Settings**.
4. Click on **Data controls** in the left sidebar.
5. Find **Export data** and click **Export**.
6. Click **Confirm Export**.
7. OpenAI will send an email or SMS with a download link (this can take anywhere from a few minutes up to 7 days depending on queue size, though it is usually fast).
8. Click the link in the email to download a `.zip` file (note: the download link expires after **24 hours**).
9. Unzip the file to find files like `chat.html` or `conversations.json` containing your complete chat history.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3QbxZr7J4L4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF14S7Je14zeDPvP69PcF81gAVavUhMxHncvRALHlks64Q4KsBYMd054l5lFbeKD7wn1nxEnYFtjcGKuuKdz6j2NLQNnh3bmhBAWKmnehm3NREO35tTK7MHmu8N13G4B_QZ1BR37DduiqMSAM7PKlGHXKRgt-as0Au9JRAS9LeFI6rafAO12r5EJePjrg)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/LP2N0tmPKoI)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/esX4PAb2rbc)
